definitions.explanation: A courier service that delivers packages directly to homes or businesses. Major services in Japan include Yamato (Kuroneko), Sagawa, and Japan Post's Yu-Pack.

examples.japanese: {宅配便|たくはいびん}が{届|とど}いた。
{宅配便|たくはいびん}で{送|おく}る。
{不在|ふざい}だったので、{宅配便|たくはいびん}の{再配達|さいはいたつ}を{頼|たの}んだ。
examples.english: I wasn't home, so I requested redelivery.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宅配便|たくはいびん}を{受|う}け{取|と}る: to receive a delivery
- {宅配便|たくはいびん}で{送|おく}る: to send by courier
- {再配達|さいはいたつ}を{頼|たの}む: to request redelivery

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has an efficient delivery system with options for time-slot delivery and easy redelivery scheduling via phone or app.

RELATED:
- {配達|はいたつ}: delivery
- {荷物|にもつ}: package, luggage
- {不在票|ふざいひょう}: missed delivery notice
